title: UAAP: 'Phenomenal' Elias Gish gives preview of potential in FEU win

blocks.text: UAAP SCHEDULE: Season 89 men’s basketball second round MANILA, Philippines—Far Eastern University got a glimpse of what its promising rookie Elias Gish can do on Wednesday in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament. The Fil-American guard out of Monterey High School in California had his breakout game, tallying 13 points, six rebounds and three blocks off the bench to help the Tamaraws defeat the University of the East Red Warriors, 94-83. His performance, however, didn’t come as a surprise to his teammates and coach Sean Chambers. READ: UAAP: FEU boosts Final Four bid, beating winless UE “He just turned 18 […]...
